name: PWI Half Marathon 2026
short_description: PWI Half Marathon 2026 is a road race on Sunday 29 November 2026 from Lapangan Saburai in Bandar Lampung, Indonesia, with 21K, 10K and 5K categories.
ai_summary: PWI Half Marathon 2026 is held on Sunday 29 November 2026 at Lapangan Saburai in Enggal, central Bandar Lampung, with a 5am start. It offers a 21K half marathon, a 10K and a 5K, priced at IDR 300,000, IDR 170,000 and IDR 150,000. The race is staged by the Lampung branch of PWI, the Indonesian journalists' association, as a lead-in to the National Press Day (HPN) 2027 events hosted in Lampung.

core_facts.organizer: PWI Lampung (Indonesian Journalists Association, Lampung branch)

faqs.question: When and where is PWI Half Marathon 2026?
faqs.answer: Sunday 29 November 2026, starting at 5am WIB from Lapangan Saburai, the field in Enggal in central Bandar Lampung. Bandar Lampung is a short flight from Jakarta, or a ferry crossing from Merak to Bakauheni followed by the toll road north.

faqs.question: What categories and fees does PWI Half Marathon 2026 have?
faqs.answer: Three: a 21K half marathon at IDR 300,000, a 10K at IDR 170,000 and a 5K at IDR 150,000, according to the organiser's poster. Entries are taken through a Bank Lampung registration form, which is paid by QRIS.

faqs.question: Who organises PWI Half Marathon 2026?
faqs.answer: PWI Lampung, the Lampung branch of Persatuan Wartawan Indonesia (the Indonesian Journalists Association), with Bank Lampung handling entries. The race is part of the build-up to National Press Day (Hari Pers Nasional) 2027, which Lampung is hosting.
